pages.text: At the shipped radius of three, build a 7×7×7 hollow cube. The controller sits in the middle of one vertical wall. The center is three blocks inside the controller at its height. The entire 5×5×5 interior must be air.$pStable Stone forms the top/bottom perimeter and the four vertical corner pillars. Flawless Glass fills the rest of the shell, except the controller. The diagrams below show each distinct layer; repeat the indicated plain middle layer.$pBottom and top: heights −3 and +3: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pMiddle layers at −2, −1, +1, +2: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pController layer: height 0: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$p$(l)Exact radius-3 shell materials$()$pStable Stone — 68$pFlawless Glass — 149$pDynamic controller — 1$p$(o)The structure radius is configurable. These counts and diagrams are for radius 3 only. Structure validation refuses unloaded targets and does not fill the cube for you.$()$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/dynamic_calculator)Input lanes and operating behavior$()
